name: work2future - Santa Clara County Workforce
description: Free career counseling, training, and employment services in San José and much of Santa Clara County
fullDescription: work2future runs America's Job Centers serving San José, Gilroy, Campbell, Morgan Hill, Saratoga, Los Gatos, Los Altos Hills, Monte Sereno, and unincorporated Santa Clara County, providing free career services to people seeking employment or career advancement.
whatTheyOffer:
- Career coaching and job search assistance
- Job search workshops
- Funding for occupational skills training (for those who qualify)
- Young adult employment program
- Employer services and hiring events
howToGetIt:
1. Visit or call an America's Job Center (open Monday-Friday, 8 am-5 pm)
2. Locations: San José (1608 Las Plumas Ave), North San José (1901 Zanker Rd), and Gilroy (379 Tomkins Ct)
3. Register online or in person
4. Meet with a career coach
5. Access training and employment services
keywords: Santa Clara, workforce, work2future, AJCC, America's Job Center, San Jose, job training, career services, Silicon Valley
